name: Corelle
source:
Corelle is the adoptive daughter of [url=/c105726]Meliagris[/url] and [url=/c105725]Fregerilla[/url]. She is called a sunny girl because of her warm, calm and gentle personality. She lost the usage of both legs due to air strikes in the war. Even though Corelle became handicap, her kind personality from before remained unchanged.

Corelle is the only person [url=/c105727]Pterios[/url] can stand, but her disagreement with her parents is becoming a burden on her mind. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
